title: The Wizard Works Zambini is its First Rack Bag
content:
Wizard Works, the London-based bag makers known for their colorful and high-quality London-made bike bags, released the Zambini Rack Bag (£175), a top-opening rack bag that prioritizes stability and easy access to your gear…

First previewed in our Brother in the Wild coverage, the bag is now ready to order…

Sitting at around 12 liters, Zambini rolls closed, giving ample and flexible storage; a wide top opening means it couldn’t be easier to rummage for snacks. Folded tight, the seam-taped liner keeps the main compartment fully waterproof for peace of mind on adventures.

Zambini attaches with removable, adjustable hitch straps that fit a huge range of racks and allow you to snap the bag on and off in seconds. The straps clip together when the bag is not in use to keep everything tidy and tangle-free. A grippy Hypalon base combined with the camlock compression strap means Zambini is super stable and off-road ready, and the tapered shape makes it dropper-compatible.

Front and rear mesh pockets take layers or more snacks, while one internal drop pocket keeps small bits findable without emptying the bag. Proudly manufactured in-house at Wizard Works’ London workshop. The Zambini Rack Bag is available now from Wizard Works direct and selected dealers, globally.

Zambini Quick Hits

  • Price: Core: £175, Custom: from £200
  • 12 Litres
  • Waterproof main compartment
  • Roll top closure for flexible storage
  • Top opening for easy gear access
  • Tapered shape for dropper post compatibility
  • Front and rear mesh pockets with replaceable elastic cord
  • One internal drop pocket
  • Grippy Hypalon base and camlock compression strap for improved stability
  • Easy on and off with removable and adjustable hitch straps
  • Hitch straps clip together when bag not in use
  • Available as part of the WW Core Range (ready to ship) in Black, Olive, Splatter, and Tan. Or Custom (made to order) in any fabric from Wizard Works’ extensive range
  • Made in London
  • Weight: 570g

See more at Wizard Works.
